messages.subject: Comparing Shiny with gWidgetsWWW2.rapache
parts:
John Verzani, the maintainer of the gWidgets set of packages and co-author with Michael Lawrence of the book Programming Graphical User Interfaces in R, wrote a very nice piece discussing Shiny compared with other GUI building systems for R at:

http://www.r-statistics.com/2012/11/comparing-shiny-with-gwidgetswww2-rapache/

I thought some of you might be interested in reading it.

With regards,
